correctness.rationale: Exactly three composite Apéry minima imply factorization length at most four. Shared-index unequal pair sums in a length-four factorization force four distinct nonatoms, so length-four sums are 4a; no length-three factorization there or length-two of 3a is possible. All remaining multiple lengths are 2 and 3. Explicit modulo-m shortest-representative comparisons establish the three families, with exact replay m=7..99 supplementing the infinite proof.
